shortDescription: The National Stock Exchange of India (NSEI.NS) allocated shares worth 67.45 billion rupees ($702.93 million) to over 100 anchor investors ahead of its initial public offering, people familiar with the matter said on Wednesday.($1 = 95.9550 Indian rupees)
